correctness.rationale: Reconstructed planar gauge as max over N facet normals, verified polar quarter-turn yields the Radon relation, and checked Birkhoff norming functionals at v0 have only orthogonal vertex indices m,m+1 (and their negatives). Applied Fu–Li Theorem 4.4 to reduce the full supremum to vertex pairs; independently calculated D_- and D_+ using chord angle and normal-ray distance, established D_+>D_- in both parity classes and the N mod 8 labels. Independently enumerated all orthogonal vertex pairs for N=6,10,14,18,22 and obtained exactly 4N pairs and sharp values 2,phi,1.60387547161,1.53208888624,1.52704223687. The finite check is not the proof for all m.
residual_risks: Only N=4m+2, real, Euclidean regular circumscribed unit polygons; no affine deformations or other residue classes.
The code enumerates finitely many regular polygons, while the infinite result uses Fu–Li and exact angle analysis.
